```{r}
# Loading necessary libraries for motif analysis
library(Signac)
library(JASPAR2020)
library(TFBSTools)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
```

```{r}
# Read in the Seurat objects for case and control that have been processed previously
pbmc_case <- readRDS("/home/tjq4954/Multiome_PBMC/Data/pbmc_peaks_case.rds")
pbmc_control <- readRDS("/home/tjq4954/Multiome_PBMC/Data/pbmc_peaks_control.rds")
```

```{r}
# Find motifs in the peak regions
pbmc_case <- FindMotifs(
  object = pbmc_case,
  assay = 'peaks',
  background = "matched"
)

pbmc_control <- FindMotifs(
  object = pbmc_control,
  assay = 'peaks',
  background = "matched"
)

# Visualize motif enrichment
head(Motif(pbmc_case))
head(Motif(pbmc_control))
```
